preconditions.description: The number of hashtags n must be between 1 and 500,000.
Each hashtag must have a length greater than 1, including the '#' character.
The total length of all hashtags (excluding the '#' character) must not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.description: Each resulting hashtag must start with the '#' character.

postconditions.expression: all(len(hashtag) <= len(original_hashtag) for hashtag, original_hashtag in zip(stdout, hashtags))
postconditions.description: The length of each resulting hashtag must be less than or equal to the length of the corresponding original hashtag.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] <= stdout[i + 1] for i in range(len(stdout) - 1))
postconditions.description: The resulting hashtags must be in lexicographical order.
